title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
statement:
Given an undirected graph represented as n nodes (numbered 0 to n-1) and a list of edges, determine the number of connected components in the graph.

A connected component is a maximal set of nodes where there is a path between any two nodes in that set.
constraints: 0 <= a < b < n (where a, b are nodes in each edge)

visibleExamples.explanation: Nodes 0, 1, 2 form one connected component. Nodes 3, 4 form another.
All nodes are connected in a single component.
No edges means each node is its own connected component.
